backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining the cricket scoring backend with persistent storage for matches and innings, exposing functions to create matches, list/get matches, start innings, and add batting/bowling entries and deliveries.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report mapping implemented feature IDs to their corresponding frontend source files, UI components, test IDs, and confidence levels for a cricket scoring app.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON snippet providing a one-sentence summary of the MatchResultPage component, noting it handles both real and demo match display.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Tailwind directives and defines light and dark theme CSS custom properties for colors, borders, and sidebar styling.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point titled 'Cricket Gods' that mounts the React app into a root div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with routes for match list, match creation, match detail, and match result pages, wrapped in a forced dark ThemeProvider.
frontend/src/components/BallInputControl: UI component rendering ball-by-ball input buttons (0–6 runs, Wide, No Ball, Wicket) with color-coded styling and callback props for each action.
frontend/src/components/BattingScorecard: Displays a formatted batting scorecard table for an innings, showing each batsman's runs, balls faced, fours, sixes, strike rate, dismissal, and extras summary.
frontend/src/components/BowlingScorecard: Displays a bowling scorecard table for an innings, calculating overs and economy from delivery data and highlighting the current bowler.
frontend/src/components/CommentaryLog.ts: Renders a collapsible accordion of ball-by-ball commentary grouped by over, highlighting wickets, wides, no-balls, fours, and sixes with color-coded badges.
frontend/src/components/FallOfWickets.ts: Displays a table of fall-of-wickets derived from innings deliveries, showing wicket number, cumulative score, over, and dismissed batsman.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Provides the app shell with a sticky header (logo, navigation buttons), a main content slot, and a footer with a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/LiveScorePanel.t: Shows the live innings scorecard including total runs/wickets, overs bowled, current run rate, and (for the second innings) target, runs needed, and required run rate.
frontend/src/components/MatchCard.tsx: Renders a clickable card summarising a match with format/status badges, team names, current score, and navigates to the match or result page on click.
Modal dialog for selecting or typing a new bowler's name at the start of an over, with quick-select buttons for previously used bowlers.
frontend/src/components/StartInningsDial: Modal dialog that collects the two opening batsmen and opening bowler names before starting a new innings.
frontend/src/components/WicketDialog.tsx: A modal dialog component for recording a wicket event, allowing the user to select a dismissal type and enter the next batsman's name with quick-select buttons for existing players.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status via a React context backed by DFINITY's AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend interactions including listing/getting matches, creating matches, starting innings, and adding batting entries, bowling entries, and deliveries.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Oswald and Inter fonts, configures Tailwind, and defines CSS custom properties for a dark cricket-themed color palette.
frontend/src/lib/cricket.ts: Utility functions for cricket scoring logic including formatting overs, calculating run rates, determining innings targets, and checking innings completion status.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with React Query's QueryClientProvider and the InternetIdentityProvider for ICP authentication.
frontend/src/pages/CreateMatchPage.tsx: A form page for creating a new cricket match, allowing users to set team names, match format (T20/ODI/Test), and overs limit, then navigating to the match detail page on submission.
frontend/src/pages/MatchDetailPage.tsx: The live match scoring page that displays innings, scorecards, commentary, and ball-by-ball input controls, managing state for batsmen, bowler, wickets, and innings transitions via multiple query hooks.
frontend/src/pages/MatchListPage.tsx: The home page listing all matches grouped by status (live, scheduled, completed) with options to create a new match, load a demo match, or refresh the list.
frontend/src/pages/MatchResultPage.tsx: Displays the final result of a completed match including winner, player of the match, and per-innings batting/bowling scorecards; handles a special demo match (id=0) with a static placeholder view.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with cricket-specific color tokens (green, gold, wicket-red, stadium-dark), custom fonts (Oswald, Inter), shadows, animations, and plugin integrations for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Defines the project state for 'Cricket Gods', a full cricket scoreboard app with backend persistence, multi-match support, and all cricket formats (T20, ODI, Test). Lists architectural notes, existing features, known issues, and image requirements.
